payload.description: The Cabinet decision approving the consultation. The March committee recommended the draft to Cabinet, so a Cabinet decision should exist, and the consultation did go ahead. We could not find one published. It may have been taken as a delegated officer decision, or simply not published. What we searched: the documents in this archive, which do not include Cabinet's own agendas and minutes — if the council can point us to the decision, we will add it.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
